hash_format: SHA-256 of the file bytes as written (UTF-8, LF)
frozen: 2026-11-22, before any score with these questions
writer: one general-purpose subagent on the smallest model (haiku), single pass, no question changed after its format check
isolation: the writer read both fact-text files (30 + 199 facts) and no question, label or result. The plan was one writer per fact; that was dropped for quota, so a question may have been worded with other facts in view despite rule 5.
rules: one short question with an explicit subject, answerable from this fact alone, no pronoun standing for the subject
at most one more question, worded clearly differently and answerable from the same fact
no attribute or condition the fact does not hold
in the fact's own language, at most 40 characters, no ASCII comma, two questions of a fact differ
each fact on its own: no wording chosen with the other facts in view

vector_text.keywords+questions: the same, then ' ' and the questions joined by a space
vector_text.questions-as-keywords: the questions appended to the fact's keywords, so tags, the word index and the vector text all carry them

limit: a question that is in its own fact's vector text cannot serve as a calibration probe for that fact
